scope: Fixed B0 rendering requirements, deterministic inputs and CPU composition evidence; not native Renderer/GPU or complete B0 foundation acceptance

decision.lighting: Directional sun RGB1 at elevation30/azimuth45, capped original IBL strength3 yaw0, EV+1, camera background linear .18; retain source payload bytes and all mesh/materials.
decision.rationale: SunRGB3/IBL1 left dark street regions; sunRGB3/IBL3 washed out facades. RGB1/IBL3/EV+1 keeps material detail and shadow fill. Capped IBL with analytic sun gives an explicit controllable shadow source; IBL-only and uncapped-IBL-plus-sun are compared at identical camera/exposure.
decision.hdr_limit: Luminance cap4 suppresses bright sources including reflections/building highlights; no claim of complete sun separation, physical energy conservation or photometric calibration. Original pyscene specifies environment intensity10 only.
decision.camera: 7 named views, 30-second closed out-and-back route sampled at60Hz, 1800 half-open frames. No walking physics or continuous-volume clearance claim.
decision.label_limit: Label view remains naturally dark with no interior/fill lighting. Its CPU color preview is not evidence of zero depth/shadow coverage; require explicit GPU depth/shadow and opaque-override sensitivity fixtures in B2/B3.

runtime_quality.pbr: Metallic-roughness GGX and Lambert diffuse with normal maps; audited AO/alpha/double-sided recipe retained. Details fixed with selected B0 foundation.
runtime_quality.shadow: CSM+PCF starting profile: 4 cascades, 2048 square each, distance 120m, practical split lambda .6, 3x3 PCF, texel snapping, last 10% blend. Bias calibrated B3 before acceptance.
runtime_quality.hdr: RGBA16F starting profile; actual format usages checked on both APIs.
runtime_quality.aa: FXAA starting profile after tone mapping before sRGB, AA-off diagnostics; parameters fixed/calibrated B3.
runtime_quality.bloom: External effect on for B5 final output, bypass also saved; threshold/knee/radius/strength fixed B4 before acceptance.

decision.invalidation: Revalidate at setup/cook when source assets, conversion, conditions, shaders, IBL cook or quality settings change. No per-draw/submit scans or diagnostic payloads.

render_report.purpose: B0 composition, light and exposure evidence only; not native GPU acceptance, exact raster reference or performance evidence

ibl.pixel_order: Blender bottom-to-top image rows; preprocessing is per texel, independent of row orientation

settings.denoiser: CPU compositor OpenImageDenoise, accurate prefilter, HDR, Cycles normal/albedo guides; original noisy EXR also retained
settings.tone_mapping: Khronos PBR Neutral applied to nonnegative scene-linear Rec.709 * 2^EV; one sRGB OETF
settings.exr: Scene-linear Rec.709 RGBA float32 ZIP, before exposure/tone mapping

sun.units: Scene-linear benchmark irradiance; not measured lux or calibrated daylight.

preprocess.formula: c=max(decoded linear RGB,0); L=dot(c,coefficients); c*=min(1,cap/max(L,1e-20)); source texels before resampling/prefilter, then strength. Bright-source suppression, not physical sun removal.

ibl.mapping: u=fract(0.5+atan2(direction.z,direction.x)/(2*pi)); v=acos(clamp(direction.y,-1,1))/pi; source top row v=0; sample inverse R_y(yaw)*direction; repeat U, clamp V.
ibl.prefilter: B3 generates diffuse irradiance, roughness-dependent specular and BRDF integration from processed source; tool and output hashes fixed before B3 acceptance.

route_clearance.limitation: Point eye path and five near-plane rays per logical frame, not swept volume, continuous frustum clearance or walkability; alpha-zero audited materials skipped.
